game.name: Clockwork Heart
title.tagline: The Grand Clockwork has stopped. You are a rabbit just wound up.
title.blurb: Forge gear, draw souls, train, daily quests. Playable start to end without signing in.
title.controls: Tap people to talk · tap signposts to leave · tap to parry in battle · Esc pause
tut.welcome: Tap Oldkey. Then the sword on the ground. Then the way out.
tut.move: Tap the ground to take a step. You don't clear the game by walking.
tut.interact: Tap a person to talk. Tap a signpost to leave.
tut.battle: Mobs fight on their own. Damage builds Rage; full Rage casts a skill.
tut.parry: When the boss's centre countdown turns green, tap to parry.
tut.hud_town: Tap people to talk · tap shops to enter
tut.hud_fort: Ding forges · Star draws souls · Greybeard trains
tut.hud_flag: A crooked rabbit on the flag. Tap it.
tut.hud_soul: Stardust buys souls. Slot them for stats.
tut.hud_forge: Ding raises gear tier. Failing won't drop it.
tut.hud_paths: New weapon, new feel. Gear, souls, skills stay.
tut.v2.boot1: This is the attic. Tap people, tap signposts.
tut.v2.boot2: Tap people to talk. Tap signposts to leave. Tap once to parry. Esc pauses.
tut.v2.boot3: Souls at the Soul Hall. Forging with Ding. Training in the square. Esc only has Continue, Bag, Settings, Save.
tut.v2.explore1: Tap a person to talk. Tap a signpost to leave.
tut.v2.explore2: Stuck? Read the goal line on screen. Progression is in the shops, not in Esc.
tut.v2.battle_auto1: Mobs fight on their own. Damage builds Rage; full Rage casts a skill.
tut.v2.battle_auto2: You can flee when it's optional. Don't flee bosses.
tut.v2.battle_parry1: Countdown turns green: tap once to parry.
tut.v2.battle_parry2: A parry counters. Tap when the fire ring lights too.
tut.v2.battle_parry3: Spamming whiffs. Slightly early can still land.
tut.v2.battle_fog1: White Fog has clones. Lock a target with Tab or 1/2/3.
tut.v2.battle_fog2: Only the real body's white flash can be hit. Hitting a phantom bites back.
tut.v2.fort1: Four shops: Ding forges gear, Starreader draws souls, the workshop sets gems, Greybeard trains.
tut.v2.fort2: Gear, souls and skills grow at the same time.
tut.v2.fort3: Weapons only set the feel. The three lines grow apart.
tut.v2.forge1: Ding raises gear tier. Failing won't drop it.
tut.v2.forge2: Enough tier opens soul slots. Souls sit on gear.
tut.v2.paths1: Two weapon sets per class, neither primary.
tut.v2.paths2: New weapon, new feel. Gear, souls and skills stay.
tut.v2.soul1: Draw souls at the Soul Hall. Stardust buys war souls.
tut.v2.soul2: Slot a soul to gain attack, defence and HP.
tut.v2.flag_hint1: A crooked rabbit on the flag. Tap the flag.
tut.v2.ng1: Echo: tougher foes. Progress carries over.
c0.intro1: The Grand Clockwork stopped. Who knows how many years ago.
c0.intro2: Gears seized. Countless toys closed their eyes.
c0.intro4: Tonight, the key on your back wound itself fifteen turns.
c0.maisui1: Don't freeze—! Run toward the skylight!
c0.reply_you: My spring can hold a while. Don't look back.
c0.reply_water: Stasis isn't a slipped catch. You can't crank it. Go!
c0.maisui3: So run. Run where you can see the Grand Clockwork.
c0.leave_stalk: (She stuffs a key cord into your chest seam.) Take it. It smells of the old attic.
c0.leave_wait: …I'll wait until the world ticks again.
c0.cut_ash: The block pile topples. The path into the attic depths is sealed.
c0.cut_road: Dawn through the skylight. Far off, the Grand Clockwork hangs above the clouds.
c0.cut_sword: The rusty longsword is heavy. Heavy enough to remind you the spring still turns.
c0.sword_have: The sword is in your hand. Heavy, but it cuts.
c0.sword1: A rusty toy longsword. The metal grip is cold and heavy.
c0.sword2: Three pulls before it leaves the crack.
c0.sword3: You pick up the rusty longsword. Tiny metal paws can barely hold it.
c0.sword_inner: Some toy has to… stand up, just once.
c0.wolf_spot: Rough gears grind behind the toy-box shadow. That is not a peaceful tick.
flavor.hut_a: The crate tipped. Stopped old toys inside.
flavor.well: The music box jammed. One note left.
flavor.bush: A gear twitched, then went still.
flavor.road_stone: Unnatural dark crystals cling to the copper axle.
flavor.dawn: That's the Grand Clockwork. Where every gear in the world begins.
flavor.look_back: The attic went still. Don't look back.
flavor.fire: Moonlight through the skylight. Aftershock of the far clock.
flavor.notice: Sanctum sealed. The lion guard sleeps overwound.
flavor.market: The stalls are empty. A cloth still says fresh wheat.
flavor.bench: The stone bench is cold. Someone sat here.
flavor.gate_arch: Cold wind leaks through the gate seam.
flavor.scarecrow: The scarecrow burned down to its frame.
flavor.rubble: Claw marks on rubble—bigger than a wolf's.
flavor.trail: Fresh prints lead toward the sanctum.
pause.title: Menu
pause.import_ok: Imported. Return to title and Continue.
path.blurb_magic: Magic · Star Mage: high skill multipliers, pairs best with soul draws.
soul.hint: Draw Soul = Gather Soul. Soul Canister green tier→orange tier. One free draw a day, gold after.

soul.pity_soft: A few more pulls — the heart glows bigger.
